senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חוּק)to draw a circle, to limit;
(denom. of חֹק) to legislate. Y. Kil. I, 27ᵇ top, a. e. שחָקַקְתִּי, v. חוֹק.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 19:8">Num. R. s. 19</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="H00442"><he>חוּקָּה</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to hollow out, to shape a receptacle.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:3:5">Y. Bets. I, 60ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>קערה שחֲקָקָהּ קוף</he> a dish which an ape has hollowed out.—Part. pass. <he>חָקוּק</he>, f. <cite ref="H01551"><he>חֲקוּקָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:1">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 65b:6">B. Bath. 65ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>מכתשת הח׳</he> the mortar which has been hollowed out (of stone &c.), opp. <he>הקבועה</he> stationary in the ground.

senses.gloss: to engrave, write with the stilus. Tanḥ. Ki Thissa 14, v. הָרַט.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 20a:11">Gitt. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>וכתב ולא וח׳</he> ‘he writes’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:1">Deut. XXIV, 1</cite>) but not ‘he engraves’ (on tablets &c.).
<cite ref="Deuteronomy 24:1">Ib.</cite> <he>חָק תוכות</he> he chisels out the surroundings (making the letters come out in relief); <he>חק יריכות</he> he digs the sides, i.e. he engraves the letters.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 68">Gen. R. s. 68</cite>; s. 78 <he>שאיקונין שלך חֲקוּקָה וכ׳</he> whose picture is engraven above (in the heavenly throne).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 4:1:2">Y. Yoma IV, beg. 41ᵇ</cite> <he>חֲקוּקִים היו</he> the inscriptions were engraven (not written with ink).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 6:8:7">Y. Ned. VI, 40ᵃ</cite> top <he>מפני צלמי … שחקוקים וכ׳</he> on account of the Chaldean images which were engraven on the walls (<cite ref="Ezekiel 23:14">Ez. XXIII, 14</cite>); a. e.

senses.gloss: to be hollowed out. Y. Erub. II, 20ᵃ top אם תֵּיחָקֵק if the block be hollowed out.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 36b:15">Sot. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>שיֵחָקֵק על וכ׳</he> (not <he>שיחקוק</he>) to have his name engraven on the jewels &c.; a. e.
